definitions.explanation: Said of a tool, device, service, or interface that works smoothly and takes little effort or learning. Formed from {使|つか}う plus the suffix 〜やすい (easy to ...).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{使|つか}いやすい。
examples.english: This app is easy to use.

examples.japanese: {使|つか}いやすい⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose tools that are easy to use.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{使|つか}いやすく⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧だ。
examples.english: People say the new site has become easier to use than before.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {使|つか}いやすい⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧: an easy-to-use tool
- {使|つか}いやすさ: usability (noun form)
- {使|つか}いやすく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become easier to use
- {使|つか}いやすいよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to arrange things for easy use

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{使|つか}いにくい→使いにくい：30397_tsukainikui⟧: hard to use — the direct opposite
- ⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧: convenient — about overall usefulness, not about ease of operation
- ⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすい: easy to understand — about comprehension rather than handling

forms.label: Conditional たら
forms.negative: {使|つか}いやすくなかったら
